warp: shader_body { vec2 d=uv-0.5; float r=length(d), an=atan(d.y,d.x); float s=1.0472; an=abs(mod(an+s*.5,s)-s*.5); vec2 k=vec2(cos(an),sin(an))*r+0.5; ret=texture(sampler_main, k).xyz*0.975; }
comp: shader_body { vec3 c=texture(sampler_main, uv).xyz; float h=atan(uv.y-.5,uv.x-.5)+time*.2; vec3 petal=.5+.5*cos(h+vec3(0.,2.1,4.2)); ret=c*1.4+petal*texture(sampler_blur1, uv).xyz*.8; }
